input_data: 24 paths: seven sweeps (required margin 0..3; level 5..-1; stability a in [-1, 1] for [[a, 1], [-1, a]]; state direction 0..90 degrees for diag(-1, 1); matrix scale 2^0..2^1023; theta across [-1, 1]; theta_dot across [-0.2, 0.2]) and seventeen short paths across one crossing (box edge theta = 1 -> nextafter(1, inf) with A1 = 0 under six in-box codes; power-of-two matrix scale across the overflow edge under five codes; level 4 -> 3.99 at V = 4 under four codes; stability a = -1e-10 -> -1e-15 with required margin 1; top eigenvalue b = -1, 0, 1e-16, 1 of diag(-1, b))
8 candidate P that NumPy calls positive definite but are exactly indefinite (seed 1041) evaluated along their weak direction

Host-owned codes MODEL_MISMATCH, STALE_STATE, INVALID_SENSOR_DATA, CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED, RUNTIME_FAULT
mathematical_model: Decision order: outside box -> NUMERICAL_OVERFLOW -> CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE (min eig P <= 0 or V < 0) -> OUTSIDE_LEVEL_SET -> NOT_CERTIFIED (x^T M x > res |x|^2) -> CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN / MARGIN_LOW (margin > res, MARGIN_LOW iff margin <= required margin) -> DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE (max eig M > res) -> NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE. Its conditions form a gate vector (box, overflow, not_positive, level, scalar_positive, certified, margin_low, not_definite) constrained by scalar_positive => not_definite and not certified (Rayleigh), certified => not not_definite, margin_low => certified. A one-parameter path crosses one threshold at a time: one gate changes, or two whose thresholds coincide (scalar_positive with not_definite for x a top eigenvector of M; certified with margin_low). Two codes are directly connected iff consistent gate vectors giving them differ by one crossing: 24 pairs among the eight rounding-free codes, 8 pairs with CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE (only through rounding: both certificate kinds refuse min eig P <= 0 when built), 4 pairs excluded.
numerical_result: Rounding-free codes reached on the paths: 8/8 (['CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE', 'MARGIN_LOW', 'NOT_CERTIFIED', 'NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE', 'NUMERICAL_OVERFLOW', 'OUTSIDE_LEVEL_SET', 'OUTSIDE_PARAMETER_BOX']); 0 of 73 path steps differ from the CIW transcription of the documented order. Transition graph: 24 allowed pairs among the rounding-free codes, 4 excluded, 8 involving CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE only through rounding; 24 of the 24 allowed transitions occurred directly in PLSR (28 code changes, 0 at a crossing the order does not allow; matrix in transition-coverage.md). Indefinite-P witnesses: 0 of 8 certifying (codes retained in the artifact). Affine certificate singular in the box: raises ValueError (neighbour theta = -0.5: CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN). Host-owned codes refused: 5/5. Constants: resolution factor 1.0, policy float64-decrease-v1.

title: Test every runtime status transition.
uncertainty: Path codes are far from rounding thresholds and platform-independent. The indefinite-P witnesses depend on eigvalsh and dot-product rounding, so only their non-certification is checked and their codes are retained in the artifact.
unresolved_assumptions: Transitions the documented order excludes (every path between the two codes passes through a third code): CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN <-> DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE (differ in at least certified, not_definite); CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN <-> NOT_CERTIFIED (differ in at least scalar_positive, certified, not_definite); MARGIN_LOW <-> DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE (differ in at least certified, margin_low, not_definite); MARGIN_LOW <-> NOT_CERTIFIED (differ in at least scalar_positive, certified, margin_low, not_definite).

The 8 transitions involving CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE are not exercised: QuadraticCertificate and every P(theta) of an AffineCertificate refuse min eig(P) <= 0 when built (an affine P(theta) that loses definiteness inside the box raises ValueError, probed here), so the code needs V < 0 at the scaled state for a P whose computed eigenvalues are positive, which only rounding produces. The eight exactly indefinite witnesses may reach it; their codes depend on eigvalsh and dot-product rounding and are retained in the artifact.

A transition is judged at the resolution of the path's steps: 'direct' means consecutive steps whose transcribed gate vectors differ by one crossing. Rounding at the crossing itself is not probed here: T107 probes the eigenvalue thresholds -res and +res within rounding, and T111 the coincident crossing of the scalar gate and the eigenvalue route at a top eigenvector.
The CIW transcription shares the documented specification with the runtime, so it checks implementation against specification (a same-specification check), not the specification itself.
